My Gogoat Journey | POKÉTOON Short
One day, an aloof boy named Julian meets a mysterious Gogoat with a scar on its forehead. To Julian’s surprise, the Gogoat suddenly hoists him onto its back and carries him across the city, hopping up balconies and leaping across rooftops as it races toward its destination. Julian is confused—where is Gogoat taking him?
